lead_raw_text:
The structure of PrCu3SiO7 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 143), with a 44-atom unit cell (Pr4Cu12Si4O28) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Cu centers with six O neighbors in octahedral motifs and Pr centers with nine O neighbors, while Si adopts a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors. The O centers coordinate to varying Cu, Pr, and Si neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu octahedra and Si tetrahedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cu octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
